facts.statement: DMHC found that Cigna's targeted retrospective medical-necessity review process for a subset of services did not comply with filed UM-11.
The CAP requires re-review of claims for the targeted Services denied for lack of medical necessity with dates of service from 2021-06-11 through 2023-06-11, inclusive.
The CAP permits exclusion of claims for Services designated by the relevant Coverage Policy as always experimental, investigational, or unproven.
The CAP permits exclusion of claims later adjusted and paid in full, including later reversals through grievance, provider appeal, or independent medical review.
The CAP permits exclusion of the specified non-diagnostic COVID testing claims.
The CAP requires Cigna to revise and re-file UM-11 and review policies implicated by those revisions.
